entities.summary: Chinese philosopher and educator (551-479 BCE) whose teachings on ethics, social relationships, and governance became the foundation of East Asian civilizational values. As history's most influential educator, Confucius established a tradition of learning that shaped Chinese imperial examinations, Korean yangban culture, and Japanese Confucian schools for over two millennia.
